Name: Sappy Seed
Effect: Accuracy -1. Ranged. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of the Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against one Target. Ignore Defenses. The User Heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. If User is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
Description: From a magical bean, the user grows a cute stalk that will attach itself to the nearest target. Once it ingrains, it will grow and grow and grow until it reaches the sky.
